2: string_matching
3: ===============
4: 
5: This is just a collection of for string matching algorithms in C++.
6: 
7: Rabin-Karp
8: automata/DFA
9: Knuth-Morris-Pratt
10: Boyer-Moore
11: 
12: It compiles
13: g++ -o stringmatching -ansi -pedantic main.cpp
14: 
15: valgrind says there are no memory errors but it does show a weird CRC mismatch thing
16: which I've seen a few times on different programs but doesn't seem to have anything to
17: do with my code and never seems to affect the programs output.
18: 
19: I've tested them by hand fairly thouroughly but I intend to add some
20: test cases and maybe alternate versions that give the line number and position
21: in the line rather than the absolute offset (0 is beginning of file).
22: 
23: Rabin-Karp, automata and KMP algorithms I based off the pseudo-code
24: in Inroduction to Algorithms, Corment et al (3rd Edition).
25: 
26: Boyer Moore I based off what used to be in the Wikipedia article(Summer '11).
27: I improved it (and used C++ instead of straight C) and am using the strong suffix rule.
28: 
29: Update 2019: iirc Boyer Moore has a bug that I never got around to fixing
30: 
31: This is MIT Licensed but obviously you probably shouldn't use these for anything
32: serious.

12: /* Rabin-Karp algorithm */
13: void rabin_karp(char *text, unsigned long filesize, char *p, int (*alphafunc)(int))
14: {
15: 	long mod_p = 0;
16: 	long ts = 0;
17: 	
18: 	char *j;
19: 	int i,k;
20: 	
21: 	short *vals = new short[256];
22: 	memset(vals, 0, 256*sizeof(short));
23: 	
24: 	
25: 	for (i=0, k=0; i<256; i++) {
26: 		if (alphafunc(i))
27: 			vals[i] = k++;
28: 	}
29: 		
30: 	long d = k;
31: 	long q = LONG_MAX/k;
32: 	
33: 
34: 	for (i=0, j=p; *j; i++, j++) {
35: 		mod_p = (d*mod_p + vals[p[i]]) % q;
36: 		ts = (d*ts + vals[text[i]]) % q;
37: 	}
38: 	
39: 	
40: 	int p_len = i;
41: 	
42: 	long h = d;
43: 	for (i=0; i<p_len-2; i++)
44: 		h = (h*d) % q;
45: 
46: 	
47: 	for (i=0; i<=filesize-p_len; i++) {
48: 		if (mod_p == ts) {
49: 			for (k=0; k<p_len; k++) {
50: 				//cerr<<text[i+k];
51: 				if (p[k] != text[i+k])
52: 					break;
53: 			}
54: 			if (k == p_len)
55: 				cout<<"Pattern found at "<<i<<endl;
56: 		}
57: 		
58: 		//ts = (d*((ts - vals[text[i]]*h)%q) + vals[text[i+p_len]]);
59: 		//ts = ((ts < 0)? q-(-ts%q) : (ts%q) );
60: 		ts = ts - (vals[text[i]]*h)%q;
61: 		ts = d*ts + vals[text[i+p_len]];
62: 		
63: 		//C usually implements truncated modulus we need floored
64: 		//see http://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Modulo_operator
65: 		ts = ((ts < 0)? q-(-ts%q) : (ts%q) );
66: 	}
67: 	
68: 	
69: 	delete[] vals;
70: }

74: /* helper function for DFA, KMP, and Boyer-Moore algorithms */
75: short * compute_prefix_func(char *p, short len)
76: {
77: 	short *pi = new short[len];
78: 	short k = 0;
79: 	pi[0] = k;
80: 
81: 	for (int q=1; q<len; q++) {
82: 		while (k>0 && p[k]!=p[q])
83: 			k = pi[k-1];
84: 		if (p[k] == p[q])
85: 			k++;
86: 		pi[q] = k;
87: 	}

110: 				if (j != p[i] || i==len)

112: 				else
113: 					trans_func[i*alpha_sz+j] = i+1;
114: 			}

122: 	}
